title: Playful Women at Boardwalk Pier, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot depicting four women playfully posing along a railing by the water or ocean boardwalk. The women are dressed in typical 1950s casual fashion, including pedal pushers, a patterned day dress, and sleeveless blouses. The photograph is somewhat faded and overexposed with two photo album hole punches at the top edge and decorative scalloped borders.
